title: Valentia
summary: Raleigh names Valentia in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). G. Valentia, the writer named with Reinerius and Antoninus. Not a place. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IV, §. VI, sig. 188b
